Theme giving panels a fixed absolute size

Source: R/plot_size.R
panel_size_theme.Rd

Sets the size of every panel of a plot in inches, so that it is identical across figures whatever the number of panels and the size or position of the legend. Add it to any ggplot, then save the plot with save_plot, which sizes the file to fit. Requires ggplot2 >= 4.0.0.

Usage

panel_size_theme(
  panel.width,
  panel.height = panel.width,
  ncol = 1,
  nrow = 1,
  panel.spacing = NULL
)

Arguments

panel.width

Width of a panel in inches: one value for all panel columns, or one value per column (e.g. from facets of different numbers of categories)

panel.height

Height of a panel in inches: one value for all panel rows, or one per row. Default is `panel.width` when it is a single value

ncol, nrow

Number of panel columns and rows, default is 1. Ignored when `panel.width` (`panel.height`) gives one value per column (row)

panel.spacing

Gap between panels in inches. If NULL (default), the theme's own spacing is kept

Value

A ggplot2 theme

See also

save_plot, theme_bioToolkit

Examples

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point() +
    theme_bioToolkit() + panel_size_theme(2.5, 2)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
save_plot(p, "mtcars.pdf")
} # }
